## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 435 captures during March 2024. Capture sessions ran as planned, with the exception of routine leave. Activity was maintained across the reporting month, and the recorded total provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results below.

## Image quality

Of the 435 captures, 27 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 6.2 per cent. The result should be considered alongside the operational context for the month, including routine leave affecting session lists. The ungradable captures were excluded from grading outcomes where image quality did not support a reliable assessment.

## Grading

Grading identified 116 referable results from the images assessed. The median lag from capture to grading was 3 days. This indicates that the central grading process continued within the expected operational workflow during March 2024. Overall, the site maintained planned capture activity, while image-quality limitations affected a proportion of submissions and remained relevant to the interpretation of the grading results.
